purpose: Synchronize provider-backed artifacts with bounded local materialization while preserving exact identity, source authority, freshness, conflict safety, privacy, storage limits, and machine-readable receipts across repositories and workflows.
core_owns: binding validation and semantic artifact identity
adapters_own: provider locator resolution from protected runtime state
provider-specific watch/poll APIs and failure translation
integrations_own: Entire session/checkpoint provenance attachment without making Entire the transfer engine or scheduler
agent or repository hooks that invoke the stable artifact-sync CLI at declared checkpoints
consumer-specific semantic bindings and protected locator resolution
forbidden_core_assumptions: one repository layout or consuming product
tracked provider URLs or provider file identifiers
persistent local copies as the default
raw-byte replacement of provider-native document formats
proof_ceiling: Architecture, binding/receipt contracts, privacy/storage policy, and deterministic local-agent handoff are defined. Rust implementation, live OAuth/provider mutation, periodic service installation, and production synchronization remain unproven.
next_transition: Implement the Rust CLI and provider adapter to the frozen v1 contracts using the READY runtime handoff packet in docs/examples/runtime-handoff.artifact-sync-rust-cli.json.
